clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says most people never reach financial freedom because they aim at the wrong goal from the start. They chase a bigger salary instead of the result they actually want.

His method: write down exactly what you want, in real specifics, after writing down what you are done putting up with. You do not have to know how the money arrives.

Don't tell the universe how it's going to happen. Let the universe figure it out on its own.

clips.send: Someone drowning in credit card debt sends this in anxiety about ever getting free
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says there was a movie where a man just said, "I want to be rich." He got his wish - he became a drug dealer, and people were trying to kill him. That is what happens when you wish for money without saying exactly what you mean.

His fix: write it down in specifics. No credit cards. No mortgage. No car payment. Debt free. Then $10 million invested, bringing in $800,000 a year without you lifting a finger.

You never have to know how - that is not your job.

Comment MONEY and I'll send you how to write your own list.

clips.send: A burned-out worker sends this in awe at the idea work could feel like play
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says the most successful people never call what they do "work." They call it creating - the one thing humans do purely because it feels good, the way a kid builds a sandcastle for hours and never complains.

The act of creating is what gives you the joy. The journey is the reward, as long as you are doing it by choice, not because someone is forcing you.

That is why he says lounging by the pool all day sounds like torture. He would rather go create something.

clips.send: Someone raised to believe they don't deserve money sends this in anger at who taught them that
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says there are three beliefs about money every wealthy person is solid on, that most people from working-class backgrounds never are.

One: money is safe to have. Two: money is good, not the root of all evil. Three, the one that trips up most people: "I deserve this money." Not because of your family. Because you decided you do.

If you do not believe all three, no amount of income will ever feel like enough.

clips.send: A skeptic of manifesting sends this in awe after watching the number actually grow live
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says people feel free for the first time in his sessions - most did not know they were carrying something that heavy until it lifted.

On camera, he walked a guest through one exercise: picture a number that would make you financially free, then do it again. Her number kept climbing higher each time, once she stopped asking "but how."

That stuck habit of "but how, but how, but how" is the only thing keeping most people's number small.

clips.send: A friend waiting for 'someday' sends this in awe at dreaming before the money ever showed up
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says he was on a friend's $65 million private jet, paid for in cash, when the guys on board complained about commercial flight delays. Someone said, "let's talk about a private plane when we have the money." He said that line would keep him broke forever.

His rule: talk about it now, before you can afford it. Wait for the money first, and it never comes at all.

Not long ago, a jet like that was a joke to him. Now he flies on a $35 million one, because he dreamed it before the income caught up.
